crusadecraft.army.not_raised: Raise the army at the War table first.
crusadecraft.army.no_camp: Go within %s blocks of a built military camp of your realm (boundary staff › Military camp).
crusadecraft.army.already: Your army is already here: %s soldier(s).
crusadecraft.army.mustered: %s soldier(s) mustered at the camp (one per %s men). /crusade armee suivre, tenir or demobiliser.
crusadecraft.army.none: No soldier of your army is mustered here.
crusadecraft.army.hold: %s soldier(s) hold the position where you are.
crusadecraft.codex.armee.p0: With the army raised (War table), go near a built $(l)military camp$() of your realm and type $(l)/crusade armee rassembler$(): your levies appear as real soldiers, one per ten men, twenty-four at most.
crusadecraft.codex.armee.p1: $(l)/crusade armee suivre$(): they follow you. $(l)tenir$(): they hold where you stand. $(l)demobiliser$(): the survivors go home. A soldier killed is ten men fewer in your army.
